title: Datasets as first-class documented sources and explorer pages
user_request: Verify correct and complete documentation of used samples under datasets/ and add Task Explorer dataset subpages with visual explanations.
scope: Registered medical experiments, retained source screens and acquired external explorer examples; no trials or acquisition.
followup_request: Each dataset should have a viewer or frozen snapshot illustrating an actual data sample and its ground truth.
snapshot_findings: All 28 sources receive a snapshot record; 23 sample/reference pairs, two input-only sources, one reference-only atlas and two unacquired metadata screens remain distinct.
Disputed annotations, paired reconstructions, simulator truth and clinical measurements retain different reference qualifications.
The main dataset view leads with the frozen sample and an explicit reference reveal; source bytes, selections, captions and hashes stay inspectable.
